sources.title: ViQ: Text-Aligned Visual Quantized Representations at Any Resolution
sources.snippet: Our work not only strongly enhances the efficiency of multimodal encoders in training process but also unifies visual and linguistic representations into a cohesive discrete framework. We evaluate the ViQ model against state-of-the-art continuous multimodal visual encoders and quantized multimodal semantic encoders across a range of experiments.
